sample_active_items.title: Casio fx-991CW ClassWiz Scientific Calculator (Exam Approved)

sample_active_items.description: Clean exam-ready condition with hard sliding protective cover. Available for short-term midterm loans or final exam weeks.

sample_active_items.title: Arduino Mega 2560 R3 Microcontroller Kit + Sensor Bundle

sample_active_items.description: Complete embedded systems lab package for EEE/CSE/ECE students working on hardware interfacing or term projects.
